waivers.verdict: Hold — no FAAB move clears the bar this week. Keep Will Reichard at kicker and the Bears at defense. The Keon Coleman stash from the last check no longer fits: Jakobi Meyers, the bench spot it would have cost, is now your starting receiver.

lineup.verdict: Hold this week's lineup — Jared Goff and Kirk Cousins start at QB and SUPER_FLEX over a Questionable Lamar Jackson; recheck his practice status before Thursday.

trades.verdict: Still send Kirk Cousins for Alvin Kamara to amandaberry — but Cousins is now your active SUPER_FLEX starter, so if the trade lands before Thursday you'll need Lamar Jackson in that slot regardless of his questionable tag.

inactives.verdict: No games close enough to check yet — the earliest Week 5 kickoff is Thursday night, with the main slate Sunday.

actions.message: Kirk Cousins for Alvin Kamara — you're all-in at RB (Gibbs/Robinson start, Kamara/Dowdle/Gainwell stacked behind them) but carrying zero backup QB in a superflex league. Cousins is the Raiders' clear starter. With Etienne down for a month, Kamara's a bench piece I'd rather have than you would right now.

evidence.note: Travis Etienne went to IR with a hamstring injury (out at least 4 games, not back before W9); Kamara is projected into New Orleans' lead backfield role while he's out.

actions.why: Kamara leads NO's backfield with Etienne on IR; still good value off a 4-QB bench, but Cousins is now my live starter, not spare depth.
